review: 1:1–1:2 טַעֲמוּ / וּרְאוּ — Psalm 34:9 (טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה), quoted because the Arabic ذُوقُوا وَانْظُرُوا is that verse.
1:3 אַשְׁרֵי הַבֹּטְחִים — 'blessed are those who trust'; the Arabic طُوبَى is the beatitude formula, and אַשְׁרֵי is its fixed Hebrew equivalent.
2:1–2:2 — the Arabic imperative هَيَّا اتَّقُوا is plural, then addresses 'all His saints'; Hebrew fronts קוּמוּ ('come!') so the plural carries across both lines.
3:1–3:2 עֲשִׁירִים נִדַּלּוּ / וַיִּהְיוּ רְעֵבִים — Psalm 34:11 is the source (רָשִׁים רְעֵבִים), and נִדַּלּוּ is the biblical verb for being brought low.
4:2 יְרֵאָיו הַנֶּאֱמָנִים — 'His faithful fearers'; the Arabic خَائِفِهِ الْأَمِين is singular, Hebrew plural for the tune, with נֶאֱמָנִים carrying 'faithful'.
